steps.name: Metrical Court Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Creator's Commons is the entry area of Rata Sum, located near the top of the city. The layout is triangular, with a waypoint and asura gates in each corner. The center of the area provides access to the Arcane Council instance.

steps.name: Incubation Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Idea Incubation Lab is an area within Rata Sum. Access to the area can be found in the Rata Sum southeastern set of asura gates. A Flax Compound Gate Guard prevents unauthorized access into the lab proper.

steps.name: Usability Station
steps.wikiText: The Usability Station is found in the South-West of Idea Incubation Lab. It is owned by Councillor Flax, as part of his compound.

steps.name: Dawnside Quay
steps.wikiText: The Dawnside Quay is the easternmost of the two landing docks located at the Rata Sum Port Authority.

steps.name: Rata Sum Port Authority
steps.wikiText: The Rata Sum Port Authority is the two-part docks of Rata Sum, connected to the floating city via two asura gates. It also appears to have an Inquest base of some sort.

steps.name: Antidawn Anchorage
steps.wikiText: The Antidawn Anchorage is the westernmost of the two docks located at the Rata Sum Port Authority.

steps.name: Port Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Rata Sum Port Authority is the two-part docks of Rata Sum, connected to the floating city via two asura gates. It also appears to have an Inquest base of some sort.

steps.name: PR-1000 Prototype Golem
steps.wikiText: The PR-1000 Prototype Golem is an asura creation located in the College of Dynamics.

steps.name: Thamaturgic Calculus
steps.wikiText: The Thamaturgic Calculus is a large device located inside the College of Synergetics.

steps.name: College of Synergetics
steps.wikiText: The College of Synergetics is an asuran scholarly society. The members of this college study magical metaphysics, cybernetic systems, and the theory of abstract structures.

steps.name: The Magihedron
steps.wikiText: The Magihedron is a point of interest within the College of Statics. Plenty of Statics students and experts can be found in this area.

steps.name: Accountancy Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Interdisciplinary Accessium is the central atrium of Rata Sum. The Dynamics, Statics and Synergetics unions can be accessed from here.

steps.name: Research Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Lower Research Stacks is an area in Rata Sum. Located within it is the headquarters of the Peacemakers, including cells which contain troublesome inmates.

steps.name: Auxiliary Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Auxiliary Study Rooms is an area in Rata Sum located south on the lowest level.

steps.name: College of Statics
steps.wikiText: The College of Statics is an asuran scholarly society within Rata Sum. Members of this college are analytical and cautious, preferring to do the work right the first time and build things that last.

steps.name: Apprentice Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Apprentice Carrels is an area in Rata Sum

steps.name: Engaged Demo Station
steps.wikiText: The Engaged Demo Station is an asuran research station located within the Applied Development Lab.

steps.name: Zojja's Workstation (Don't Touch!)
steps.wikiText: Zojja's Workstation is Zojja's lab located inside Snaff's compound.
